t: This Victorian building is Old Billingsgate, now a hospitality and events venue in the City of London. It began as Billingsgate Fish Market, which in the nineteenth century was the largest fish market in the world. It was designed by Sir Horace Jones, who worked for the City of London from 1864 until his death. He was knighted in 1886 and served as president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. His most recognised work is Tower Bridge, which was finished after he died. Jones is relatively little known, though his work is widely recognised.
